# New Epics

## Right Align Numbers

Throughout the application the tables that have numeric columns (numbers, percentages, etc) should be right aligned on decimal point where the column is a float rather than an integer.

There may be other places I miss but here are some exact locations I know about:

- Universe Table:
  - Distribution
  - Dist/Year
  - Yield
  - Avg Purch Yield %
  - Last Price
  - Mst Rcnt Sell $
  - Position
- Accounts Tables:
  - Open Positions
    - Buy
    - Quantity
    - Expected $
    - Last $
    - Unrlz Gain %
    - Unrlz Gain$
    - Days Held
    - Target Gain
    - Target Sell
  - Sold Positions
    - Quantity
    - Sell
    - Days Held
    - Cap Gain$
    - Cap Gain%
  - Dividend Deposits
    - Amount

## Consistent Date Format

Throughout the application the tables that have date columns should be consistently formatted as MM/DD/YYYY.

There may be other places I miss but here are some exact locations I know about that are formatted incorrectly:

- Accounts:
  - Sold Positions
    - Buy Date
    - Sell Date

## Column Widths

Throughout the application some columns are too narrow to display their content properly, causing truncation. The column widths should be adjusted to fit the content appropriately.

There may be other places I miss but here are some exact locations I know about:

- Universe Table:
  - Ex-Date
